simple.meaning: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בּוֹא (H935) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2592 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בּוֹא (bôwʼ) means to go or come (in a wide variety of applications) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 2 21.

definitions.short: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
